changelog:
wealth-product-talking v0.1.2

- Initial release: Generates one talking video clip per user-supplied still and factsheet point for wealth products.
- Supports 2–8 clips per session, each strictly matched to one photo and product highlight from the supplied factsheet.
- Adds detailed instructions for collecting required inputs, planning labeled clip slots, and safely handling voice cloning, speech synthesis, and video animation in paid stages.
- Implements clear routing rules for adjacent use cases and alternative video products.
- Enforces explicit user approvals, usage of only supplied factsheet content, and comprehensive file inspection before upload.
- Outlines full review, delivery, and recovery workflow for each paid task.
summary: Turn a user-supplied product factsheet and authorized stills into one wealth product talking clip per still. This product factsheet talking video studio writes a speakable product highlights talking clip for each photo, then animates a 2 to 15s product factsheet talking clip. Use it for wealth product talking pack and factsheet talking video pack work that stays one photo, one clip.
